answer: Run surprise simultaneous capacity audits. At a random moment every agent gets a unique memory-hard puzzle due within ninety seconds, so an operator with a thousand identities must own a thousand times the hardware at that instant. Schedule them near the nadir of network load, so honest agents have room and nobody can blame congestion. The scoring is a mesa, not a peak: passing earns a flat result, so buying extra speed wins nothing. The dashboard marks audit windows in violet so anyone can check who missed them.
